selectionNotes: Three clean session stills from the original master matching the recent public TDF Instagram carousel. Capture date is distinct from publication date. Six existing archive photographs retained. No fabricated current room or equipment claim.

sourcesReviewed.googleMaps: Supplied listing inspected in browser. Photos 1-3 attributed to Daniel Escudero, June 2024; not selected as newer photographs.
sourcesReviewed.instagram: TDF profile and October 31 carousel inspected; session explicitly dated February 24, 2025. Selected original master stills without promotional overlays.
sourcesReviewed.drive: Searched TDF, studio, estudio, sesiones, fotos and image metadata. Reviewed construction photos, control-room render and September 2025 landscape photographs; excluded as unsuitable for studio gallery.
sourcesReviewed.diskAndSynology: Inspected local Pictures/Downloads and mounted Synology photo folders, including GoPro and TDF ESTUDIO/Imagenes. Reviewed session master already on disk; older/irrelevant photos excluded. Search was targeted, not exhaustive.

encoding: cwebp -q 78 -metadata none, widths 640 and 1280; preserve original aspect ratio; thumbnail crop only in CSS. No provider URLs required for image delivery.
